abandon v..en: The hikers decided to abandon the route after the weather suddenly worsened.
abandon v..zh: 天氣突然惡化後，登山者決定放棄原本的路線。

aboriginal adj..en: The museum exhibition introduces aboriginal art from several communities across the region.
aboriginal adj..zh: 博物館展覽介紹了這個地區數個社群的原住民族藝術。

accomplishment n..en: Finishing the research project was a major accomplishment for the whole team.
accomplishment n..zh: 完成這項研究計畫對整個團隊來說是一項重要成就。

accountable adj..en: Team leaders are accountable for explaining important decisions clearly to everyone.
accountable adj..zh: 團隊領導者有責任向所有人清楚說明重要決定。

acoustic adj..en: The band performed an acoustic version of the song at the school event.
acoustic adj..zh: 樂團在校園活動中演奏了這首歌的不插電版本。

ago adv..en: Our school library was renovated two years ago and now has more study space.
ago adv..zh: 我們學校圖書館兩年前整修過，現在有更多自習空間。

allow v..en: The new rules allow students to borrow three books at one time.
allow v..zh: 新規定允許學生一次借三本書。

audio adj..en: The teacher shared an audio recording so students could practice listening carefully.
audio adj..zh: 老師分享了一段音訊錄音，讓學生可以仔細練習聽力。

barbershop n..en: A small barbershop opened beside the market earlier this summer.
barbershop n..zh: 今年夏天早些時候，市場旁開了一間小理髮店。

bulb n..en: The gardener planted each bulb in loose soil before the rainy season.
bulb n..zh: 園丁在雨季前把每顆球莖種進鬆軟的土壤裡。

carbon n..en: The science class discussed how carbon moves through natural systems on Earth.
carbon n..zh: 自然科課堂討論了碳如何在地球的自然系統中循環。

children n..en: The library created a quiet reading corner especially for young children.
children n..zh: 圖書館特別為年幼兒童設置了一個安靜的閱讀角落。

chilly adj..en: The morning was chilly, so everyone wore a light jacket outside.
chilly adj..zh: 早晨有些寒冷，所以大家外出時都穿了薄外套。

citizen'.en: Every citizen can learn how local government decisions affect the community.
citizen'.zh: 每位公民都可以了解地方政府的決策如何影響社區。

creative adj..en: Her creative solution helped the class finish the project with fewer materials.
creative adj..zh: 她富有創意的解決方法讓全班用更少材料完成了專題。

deal n.en: The two groups reached a deal after discussing the schedule for several days.
deal n.zh: 兩個小組討論行程數天後達成了協議。

dig v..en: Students will dig a small hole before planting the young tree.
dig v..zh: 學生會先挖一個小洞，再種下幼樹。

distinctively ad.en: The building is distinctively modern, with large windows and simple geometric lines.
distinctively ad.zh: 這棟建築具有鮮明的現代風格，擁有大面窗戶與簡潔的幾何線條。

diversion n..en: The road diversion added ten minutes to the morning bus route.
diversion n..zh: 道路改道讓早晨公車路線多花了十分鐘。

efficient adj..en: This efficient system reduces waiting time at the school office each morning.
efficient adj..zh: 這套有效率的系統縮短了每天早上在學校辦公室的等待時間。

express v..en: Students can express their ideas clearly during the group discussion.
express v..zh: 學生可以在小組討論中清楚表達自己的想法。

feet n..en: The table is six feet long and fits easily across the room.
feet n..zh: 這張桌子長六英尺，可以輕鬆放進房間裡。

fond adj..en: She is fond of reading historical novels during the winter vacation.
fond adj..zh: 她很喜歡在寒假期間閱讀歷史小說。

foolish adj..en: It would be foolish to ignore the instructions before starting the experiment.
foolish adj..zh: 在開始實驗前忽略說明會是不明智的。

generously ad.en: The local bookstore generously donated dictionaries to the community learning center.
generously ad.zh: 當地書店慷慨地捐贈字典給社區學習中心。

happily ad.en: The students happily welcomed the exchange group at the school entrance.
happily ad.zh: 學生們開心地在校門口迎接交換學生團。

hardly ad.en: We could hardly hear the announcement because the hallway was extremely noisy.
hardly ad.zh: 因為走廊非常吵，我們幾乎聽不到廣播。

hear v..en: You can hear the school bell clearly from the sports field.
hear v..zh: 你可以從操場清楚聽到學校鐘聲。

identify v..en: The guide helped us identify several native plants along the forest trail.
identify v..zh: 導覽員幫助我們辨認森林步道旁的數種原生植物。

indebted adj..en: The researcher felt indebted to the volunteers who supported the long project.
indebted adj..zh: 研究人員很感激那些支持這項長期計畫的志工。
